# Curious Kaizer

> Premium custom design and software engineering agency specializing in custom SaaS platforms, AI integrations, 3D web configurations, and business dashboards.

## Core Offerings & Services

- **Custom Web & E-Commerce**: High-performance corporate sites, portfolios, and conversion-optimized storefronts.
- **SaaS & Web Applications**: Bespoke CRM systems, business pipeline trackers, and real-time dashboards (such as CRM Pro).
- **AI & Automation Tools**: Custom AI automation agents, chatbot integrations, and voice-controlled browser automation.
- **3D Visualizers**: Three.js/WebGL-based 3D product configurators (e.g. jewelry customizers).

## Pricing Packages

- **Basic Business Website**: Starts at ₹15,200. Perfect for small businesses looking to establish a professional presence.
- **E-Commerce Storefront**: Starts at ₹21,900. Features advanced product catalogues, payment gateways, and inventory management.
- **Custom Web & SaaS Apps**: Starts at ₹33,900. Tailored solutions for complex workflows, customer portals, and enterprise software.

## Featured Live Client Platforms & Case Studies

- [HANBORO Watches Storefront](https://hanborowatches.in) - Luxury mechanical horology e-commerce storefront engineered by Curious Kaizer featuring kinetic complication video reels, daylight-to-luminescence split sliders, and sub-second checkout.
- [Club Re Straddle Portal](https://www.clubrestraddle.com/) - Private club management and access control ecosystem engineered by Curious Kaizer featuring KYC player profiles, scannable QR gate passes, and real-time operations dashboard.
- [AUCO × AIWA Operations Portal](https://auco-co.vercel.app/) - Multi-brand enterprise ERP and pan-India dealer telemetry pipeline.
- [Aloha Estate Custom Portal](https://aloha-estate.vercel.app/) - Real estate operations portal with real-time Meta lead ads synchronization and deal pipeline Kanban.
- [DODD Aero Lab 3D Visualizer](https://shoes-ten-pi.vercel.app/) - Interactive 3D WebGL footwear configurator with 360-degree orbit cameras and dynamic colorway customizer.
- [HIS DRINK 3D Experience](https://3d-brown-iota.vercel.app/) - Zero-gravity 3D beverage motion showcase with real-time lighting physics and floating particle fields.
- [IRASTRA Celestial Universe](https://irastra.vercel.app/) - Real-time 3D planetary solar system and astronomical birth chart navigation engine.
- [StaySphere PMS](https://staysphere-phi.vercel.app/) - Hospitality SaaS hotel management system with live room status matrix and front-desk check-in workspace.
- [AlmostReal Club®](https://almostreal-club.vercel.app/) - Luxury digital fashion showroom and gated private club e-commerce experience.
- [Notary & Legal Case System](https://notatry-system.vercel.app/) - LegalTech document workflow tracking system with encrypted document vault and PDF indexing.
- [CuriousCRM Pro](https://crm-coral-one.vercel.app/) - Modular sales pipeline Kanban CRM with predictive lead scoring and conversion telemetry.
- [Serverless Web Analytics](https://analytics-indol-psi.vercel.app/) - Lightweight privacy-first real-time web telemetry and click funnel visualizer.
- [Civic Infrastructure Portal](https://public-toilet-sepia.vercel.app/) - Public geospatial utilities mapping system with interactive Mapbox vector rendering.
